title: Tangkhul Village Homestay Network
tagline: Stay with a village household in the hills above Ukhrul.

sections.heading: About this stay
sections.body: Six participating village households around Ukhrul open a room and share their table, so a night here is spent inside a Tangkhul Naga home rather than in a hotel built for visitors. Meals are included, and each household hosts a small number of guests at a time.

sections.heading: What guests can expect
sections.body:
A private room in a working village household
Meals cooked and shared with the host family
Hosted introductions to local craft and food
Six households across Ukhrul, so a return visit can mean a different home

sections.heading: Good to know
sections.body:
₹1,400 per room per night, meals included
Ukhrul district, Manipur
Enquire on OneStop Manipur to check availability

title: Manipur Sangai Festival 2026
tagline: Ten days of craft, cuisine, sport and nightly performance across Imphal.

sections.heading: About the festival
sections.body: The Manipur Sangai Festival is the state's flagship tourism festival, bringing craft, cuisine, indigenous sport and nightly performance to venues across Imphal. It usually runs from 21 to 30 November; the exact programme and any entry charge are announced by the Department of Tourism each year.

sections.heading: What's on
sections.body:
Craft and cuisine stalls from across Manipur's districts
Indigenous sport demonstrations
Nightly cultural performance
Free admission, multiple venues across Imphal

sections.heading: Good to know
sections.body:
21 to 30 November 2026 (dates provisional, announced annually)
Multiple venues across Imphal
Free admission
Organised by the Department of Tourism, Government of Manipur
